description: Stack-agnostic orchestrator-subagent: delegate-only tech-lead, reads the available project roles and produces a machine-readable plan (Task N -> @<prefix>-<role>) with modes Sequential/Parallel-max2/Gated. Stretches as general prerequisite stack packs (backend-laravel/node-frontend/dart-flutter/python-backend).

interview.q: Project agent name prefix (like a stack pack)?

notes.prerequisite: Installed together with the stackpack as a general orchestrator. {PACK_PREFIX} must match the stackpack prefix in order for @<prefix>-<role> resolved to play his role.
notes.verify_workflow: Agent NOT workflow - node --check does not apply.
